versions.changelog:
- Major reduction in built-in travel knowledge: 35 reference files covering communications, payment, planning, and transport have been removed.
- Lightweight version now relies more on structured flyai commands for flight, hotel, train, and attraction search.
- Core skill description, routing logic, and intent patterns remain unchanged; no visible change in supported features for end users, but knowledge base coverage is reduced.
- Updated skill version metadata in SKILL.md.
Re-publish with full tags after GitHub import

TongTu 0.3.0 — Enhanced multilingual China travel guide for foreign tourists.

- Expanded to support multilingual queries (English, Korean, Japanese, etc.).
- Now covers searches for flights, hotels (including Marriott Group), trains, and attractions using FlyAI.
- Improved guidance for practical travel needs, including visa, payment (Alipay, WeChat Pay), local transport, and SIM/eSIM setup.
- Structured command routing prioritizes travel search intent for faster, clearer results.
- Recommends using Alipay AliTrip mini-program for bookings.
